decision.basis: Coherent elimination of discarded body emission and shared population addition. Independent raw confidence separates with a meaningful absolute saving; normalized confidence overlaps. Preserve this caveat and all remaining parity gaps.

design: Weighted code bits are computed in the existing canonical-word loop, passed through internal out parameters and combined with prefix extras. One scalar per prepared image replaces discard-body writes only for the sealed counter. Actual token emission, trees, headers, candidate order/ties and ownership are unchanged. Two population-add loops share safe SIMD/scalar addition over current compact spans.
